description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Arcane Strike, light II spell-like ability

Benefit: Whenever you successfully hit an enemy that is vulnerable to light with a melee weapon you've imbued with your Arcane Strike feat, you deal an additional 1d6 points of holy damage to the target of your attack. The struck creature must also succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Strength modifier) or become staggered for 1 round.

system.requirements: Arcane Strike, light II spell-like ability
